title: Coverage Analysis Output
description: Coverage analysis results from the coverage-analyst agent.

line_coverage.description: Percentage of source lines exercised by the test suite

branch_coverage.description: Percentage of branches (if/else, switch) exercised by the test suite

uncovered_paths.description: Files and line ranges not covered by tests, with explanations

file.description: Relative path to the source file with uncovered lines

lines.description: Line numbers not covered by any test

reason.description: Explanation of why these lines are uncovered (e.g. error path, dead code)
